chunks: And whatever is in it from Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf al-Khaffāf, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillah, from al-Haytham ibn Abī Masrūq al-Nahdī, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlwān, from ʿAmr ibn Thābit, from Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf al-Khaffāf.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating the author’s route of narration
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ طَرِيفٍ الْخَفَّافِ: the named transmitter to whom this chain leads
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: from my father; part of the transmission route

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf al-Khaffāf in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf al-Khaffāf. Its significance is bibliographical and related to hadith transmission, documenting the route of narration rather than presenting a substantive matn teaching.
